text:
alina: Heads-up — intake for a new model: Kangal-30B (open-regressive). We should do a quick prioritization + bring-up checklist. Need owners for quant, evals, doc, and release comms.

mike: +1. What are the high-level asks? latency/cost targets?

alina: Primary goal: 2x quality over existing 13B baseline on our summarization tests, with <=1.5x per-token cost. Latency targets: p95 < 450ms for 256 tokens on dedicated GPUs.

sujay: I can own quant experiments. Plan to try INT8 with bitsandbytes + a GPTQ 4-bit run if INT8 fails. I'll run perf/quality matrix over the weekend.

caroline: I'll run the eval suite (summarization, instruction-following, MMLU-ish probes, and our regression prompts). Need a curated prompt set from the docs team.

alina: eva -> docs & announcement?

eva: I can write model-catalog entry + quickstart snippet. Will need model card details (license, origin, config) from whoever pulls the model. ETA: Monday COB for initial PR.

alina: owners: sujay (quant), caroline (evals), mike (serving/runtime tuning + canary), eva (docs & announce). I'll add a checklist now.

alina: CHECKLIST:
- model artifacts pulled to s3://redwood-models/kangal-30b (sha + provenance)
- model card + license recorded in model-catalog PR
- quant runs: FP16 baseline, int8, gptq-4bit (if needed)
- perf bench: p50/p95 latency, throughput @ batch sizes [1,4,8], memory footprint
- quality bench: summarization regset, instruct evals, rouge/bert scores, and human spot check on 50 samples
- create catalog entry w/ verified perf profile
- docs quickstart + SDK example + migration notes
- canary rollout plan + fallback variant (kangal-13b)
- announcement draft for #product and release notes

mike: For canary: suggest route 5% to dedicated-pool-canary for 24h, auto-roll back to kangal-13b if latency or error rate exceeds thresholds. Threshold rules: p95 latency > 600ms OR error_rate > 1%.

sujay: Quick datapoint from local int8 run (toy): perplexity delta vs fp16 small on lm1b (~+0.6), but generation logits diverge on long context in a few seeds. I'll run calibration with 128-token contexts.

caroline: Eval plan: schedule CI job eval/kangal-30b that posts a report to #eng-ml and creates an issue if any metric regresses > 3%. Also run the A/B comparator against 13B on our anchor prompts.

eva: Drafted model-catalog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/812 — includes config, sample call, and initial perf numbers from FP16. Please add quant results as they come.

alina: Good. Also need docs snippet for SDK streaming example. Eva, here's a minimal example you can paste:```python
from redwood import Client
rc = Client(api_key="<REDACTED>")
resp = rc.generate(model="kangal-30b", prompt="Summarize: ...", stream=True)
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```

eva: Nice, will include. Also planning announcement copy: "Kangal-30B available in alpha on Dedicated — high quality summarization with configurable latency/cost tradeoffs." Will run by product for sign-off.

mike: Infra notes: need to profile KV cache size and checkpoint sharding. If we go GPTQ-4bit, alloc pattern changes. I'll open infra ticket and attach perf baseline.

mike: @deploy-bot please schedule canary job once quant + eval are green.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued: job_id=canary-176812. Will trigger after CI pass.

caroline: Small risk: on the QA set we saw a hallucination cluster on long-summary cases with the initial FP16 config. I tagged 37 examples in the eval report. We should add a focused human review cohort.

sujay: Thanks for flag. I'll run nucleus sampling tuning (top_p) experiments and temperature ablations. Might be quant-related or prompt-formatting.

alina: Timeline proposal:
- Today: owners assigned, catalog PR draft up (eva)
- By Mon 12:00 PT: sujay posts quant matrix, caroline posts eval report
- Mon 18:00 PT: infra + canary job scheduled if green
- Tue: 24h canary, then wider rollout if no regressions

caroline: Sounds realistic. I'll prepare the regression tickets and a small human-review rota.

eva: Also planning the announcement cadence: internal docs -> #product & #eng -> social once metrics validated. Draft will be in the PR.

alina: Ok team — thanks. If anyone hits blockers ping me or escalate in #eng-ml. :rocket:

mike: sgtm

sujay: on it

caroline: will post eval report shortly

eval-bot: Eval run finished: run_id=eval-176812-1; summarization_rougeL_mean=0.42; instr_f1=0.78; regressions_detected=37 (see report).

deploy-bot: Canary job canary-176812 started at 1768123600.

mike: rolling watch on canary — keeping slack window open for 24h.

alina: thanks everyone, follow-up sync Wednesday if needed.
